V=\operatorname{int}(A)\cap\{(x,y):x+y>0\},\qquad W=\operatorname{int}(A)\cap\{(x,y):x+y<0\}.

Since the two sets defined by the strict inequalities are open in $\mathbb{R}^2$, $V$ and $W$ are open in $\operatorname{int}(A)$. \end{proof}
